summary: Routine maintenance check: repositories current and no system repairs needed

No package transaction, system configuration change, service restart or job operation was performed. Retained KDE, keyboard, repository, graphics, gaming and official ChatGPT configuration.

rollback: No installed-system changes require rollback. Retain private audit records and sanitized receipt. The isolated repository-check database is disposable and must never replace the live package database. No rollback was executed or tested.
problem: No current package database, missing target-package file or failed-unit problem was observed. No pending repository update was found.
solution: No repair needed on the evidence collected. Existing maintenance mechanism and settings retained.
reproduction: Not applicable: routine health check with no reproduced distribution defect.
